forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, 4 visits were completed. No zone surveys, technical surveys, clearances or zone declarations were completed. There are 4 zones surveyed so far and 0 areas released or cleared.

For the officer’s attention, the access feed shows 9 zones closed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No reports or dossiers were held, and no new plan was approved; the current plan is P01.

The forecast made in week 1 covers the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is already done. Its range is 9 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 7 to 13 zones declared free this season.
